dish.title: Mushroom Stroganoff with Sour Cream, Dill, and Buttered Egg Noodles
dish.description: Thick-sliced cremini mushrooms seared in batches until deeply browned, then simmered with onion, garlic, sweet paprika, Dijon mustard, and vegetable broth and finished with sour cream and fresh dill. Served over buttered wide egg noodles.

recipe_version.title: Mushroom Stroganoff with Sour Cream, Dill, and Buttered Egg Noodles
recipe_version.description: Thick-sliced cremini mushrooms seared in batches until deeply browned, then simmered with onion, garlic, sweet paprika, Dijon mustard, and vegetable broth and finished with sour cream and fresh dill. Served over buttered wide egg noodles.

ingredients.name: low-sodium vegetable broth
ingredients.display_name: low-sodium vegetable broth whose label lists vegetables, salt, and herbs only

ingredients.name: wide egg noodles
ingredients.display_name: wide egg noodles whose label lists wheat flour and eggs

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp noodle pot, 1/2 tbsp (1 1/2 tsp) sauce

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Slice the mushrooms 1/3 inch thick, finely chop the onion, mince the garlic, and chop the dill. Set the sour cream out.

steps.title: Heat the noodle pot
steps.body: Fill a 6-quart pot with 12 cups water and 1 tbsp salt, cover, and set it over high heat. It takes about 12 minutes to come to a boil, which runs inside steps 3 and 4 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Sear the mushrooms
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Add half the mushrooms in one layer and leave them 3 minutes, then stir and cook until deep brown, 2 minutes more. Move to a plate and repeat with the remaining 1 tbsp oil and mushrooms. Season with 1/2 tsp salt.

steps.title: Soften the onion
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium and melt 1 tbsp butter in the skillet. Cook the onion, stirring, until soft and pale gold, about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute, then sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Cook the noodles
steps.body: Add the noodles to the boiling pot and cook until tender, about 7 minutes. Drain, return to the pot, and toss with 2 tbsp butter. This runs inside step 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.body: Whisk in the broth and mustard, scraping up the browned bits, and bring to a simmer, about 1 minute. Return the mushrooms with 1 tsp salt and the pepper and simmer until the sauce coats a spoon, about 6 minutes.

steps.title: Finish with sour cream
steps.body: Turn the heat to low. Stir a spoonful of sauce into the sour cream, then stir the sour cream into the skillet with half the dill and warm 1 minute without letting it boil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Divide the buttered noodles among shallow bowls, spoon the stroganoff over, and scatter the remaining dill.

coverage_contribution: Russia has no meal in the catalog. A vegetarian creamy-sauce dinner over noodles; the catalog's mushroom leads are a walnut bolognese, a ramen, a barley soup, a pozole, and a three-cup stir-fry.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with hungarian-chicken-paprikash: mushrooms with Dijon and dill, no chicken, and a broth sauce finished with sour cream. Compared with mushroom-walnut-bolognese: a creamy sour cream sauce on egg noodles, not a tomato-walnut ragu on pasta. Compared with polish-mushroom-barley-krupnik: a sauced noodle dinner, not a barley soup. Compared with kasespatzle-caramelized-onions: mushrooms in a sour cream sauce, not cheese-baked spaetzle.
not_duplicate_of: Not beef stroganoff; mushrooms are the only main.
